Contributing to treeshapesim

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for considering a contribution. This guide covers bug reports, changes to the code and the tests.

Bug reports and questions

Open an issue at https://github.com/diogoprov/treeshapesim/issues with a minimal reproducible example (the reprex package helps), including set.seed() when the problem involves random draws, and the output of sessionInfo(). The same seed gives the same trees on the same platform, but not necessarily across platforms (see ?sim_tree_shape).

Changes to the code

  • Discuss larger changes in an issue first.
  • Work on a branch and open a pull request against main.
  • Follow the existing style: tidyverse style, lines of at most 80 characters, roxygen2 documentation for every function (internal functions with @noRd).
  • Add tests for new behaviour, and a test for every new error or warning message, which must be unique.
  • Add a bullet to NEWS.md under the development version.
  • Run devtools::document(), devtools::check() and pkgcheck::pkgcheck() before you open the pull request.

Statistical software standards

The package follows the rOpenSci general and probability-distribution statistical software standards. Compliance is documented with @srrstats tags from the srr package, next to the code or test that meets each standard; standards that do not apply are tagged @srrstatsNA in R/srr-stats-standards.R. If a change affects a standard, update its tag, and check with srr::srr_stats_pre_submit().

Tests

The regular tests run with devtools::test() in less than a minute.

Extended tests

Extended tests of parameter recovery over many seeds and of the decrease of the error of the estimates with the number of tips are in tests/testthat/test-extended.R. They are skipped unless the environment variable TREESHAPESIM_EXTENDED_TESTS is "true":

Sys.setenv(TREESHAPESIM_EXTENDED_TESTS = "true")
devtools::test(filter = "extended")

They need no downloads or special hardware, take about 20 seconds on a recent laptop, and produce no files to inspect.

Validation scripts

The longer validation runs behind the performance claims in the documentation are scripts in data-raw/ (validate_estimators.R, validate_sampling.R, benchmark_topology.R), with their results in data-raw/validation/. Some need archived packages (apTreeshape, laser); see the header of each script.

Code of Conduct

Please note that this project is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing, you agree to abide by its terms.
